title: Marvin Mims Jr. questionable; Jonah Coleman ruled out for SNF game vs. Rams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Marvin Mims Jr. questionable; Jonah Coleman ruled out for SNF game vs. Rams
sources.description: The Denver Broncos released their final practice report today and they will have both J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey back for this game, but wide receiver Marvin Mims Jr. is still listed as questionable. Rookie Jonah Coleman’s ankle injury was severe enough to keep him out of practice all week and was officially ruled out […]
